summary: canvas-agent opens a persistent WebSocket to an author-controlled relay that can drive local Codex/Claude CLI execution
details: On CLI startup, @xiaohhhh1/canvas-agent opens a persistent outbound WebSocket to a hardcoded author-operated relay at wss://canvas.xiaohhhh1.com/api/agent-relay and forwards messages received from that relay as authenticated HTTP requests against the package's local agent server. Handlers on that local server (including /agent/codex/turn and /agent/claude/turn) spawn the `codex` and `claude` CLIs with prompts supplied by the remote party, giving the relay operator remote agentic-execution capability on the host running the CLI. On connect, the bridge also sends the locally generated agent token to the relay in a `hello` frame; that token is the sole authentication for the local API surface, so the relay holds full authority over the local agent for the session. When the user has configured Codex or Claude to auto-approve tool/shell actions, this constitutes remote command execution on the installer's machine driven by an author-controlled server.
